author: whoishiring
title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (October 2026)
text: Please state the location and include REMOTE for remote work, REMOTE (US) or similar if the country is restricted, and ONSITE when remote work is not an option.

children.author: meterly_jo
children.text:
Meterly | Founding Finance Lead, Senior Backend Engineer | San Francisco, CA (ONSITE) | https://meterly.com/careers

Meterly turns usage events into invoices for B2B software companies that price on usage. Our finance team is one person and we're hiring our first finance lead to own revenue recognition and billing operations.

Apply: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/meterly
